definition: evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret
example: She offered a poignant tribute to her late mentor.

definition: seeking to exploit others; rapacious
example: The predatory lender charged obscene fees.

definition: a fictitious name used by an author
example: She wrote her memoirs under a pseudonym.

definition: aggressively greedy or grasping
example: The rapacious predator devoured its prey in minutes.

definition: peripheral; only slightly relevant
example: His remarks were merely tangential to the debate.

definition: equivalent in seriousness to
example: The vote was tantamount to a vote of no confidence.

definition: regarded with great respect or reverence
example: The venerated leader retired after forty years.

definition: forming a very small remnant of something that was once larger
example: The ostrich has vestigial wings it cannot use.

definition: having a strong desire for revenge
example: His vindictive streak alienated old friends.

definition: attractively lively and animated
example: Her vivacious personality lit up the room.

definition: lacking sophistication or good taste
example: His vulgar jokes alienated the audience.

definition: to shake or flicker; to be undecided
example: She wavered at the threshold.

definition: a witty and typically sharp or sardonic remark
example: His wisecrack lightened the tense mood.

definition: to dispute angrily or peevishly
example: They wrangled over the wording for hours.

definition: extreme anger
example: The king wrath fell upon the conspirators.

definition: to forcibly pull something from a persons grasp
example: He wrested the confession from his opponent.

definition: a person who is fanatical and uncompromising
example: The zealot refused to negotiate.

definition: the time at which something is most powerful or successful
example: The empire reached its zenith in the second century.

definition: an opponent or enemy
example: She sized up her adversary with care.

definition: to diminish or put at rest; to relieve
example: He tried to allay her fears with a calm explanation.

definition: something that deviates from what is standard or expected
example: The data point was an anomaly worth investigating.

definition: to take or claim for oneself without justification
example: He arrogated authority he did not possess.

definition: a statement or proposition regarded as self-evidently true
example: It became an axiom of modern physics.

definition: to adjust or mark so as to ensure accuracy
example: The lab calibrated the instruments before each run.

definition: continually finding fault; petty criticism
example: His carping review soured the opening night.
